# supabase-js (vendored)

- File: `supabase.js` — UMD build of `@supabase/supabase-js` (MIT)
- License: `supabase.LICENSE`
- Loaded **only** by `remote.js` when `WWM_CONFIG.remoteEnabled` is true and URL/anon key are set.
- Do not add a `<script src="./vendor/supabase.js">` to `index.html`; that would talk to Supabase even when remote is off.
